lead.title: ChatGPT Work — OpenAI rebrands Codex into long-running autonomous agent
lead.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work, rebranding Codex into a tool that can run autonomous workflows for hours, integrating with Slack, Teams, Google Drive, and SharePoint. The launch includes Scheduled Tasks and a credit-based billing system powered by the GPT-5.6 model, while the existing ChatGPT desktop app is being rebranded as 'ChatGPT Classic.'

top_stories.title: Tesla's AI5 with 2nm-class node tapes out at Samsung Foundry — production starts soon, months after TSMC tape out
top_stories.summary: Tesla's AI5 processor taped out at Samsung Foundry using a 2nm-class process, featuring a 384-bit GDDR6/GDDR7 memory interface for use in cars, robots, and data centers.

top_stories.title: European AI defense startup Helsing raises $1.8B at $18B valuation
top_stories.summary: Helsing closed a $1.8 billion Series E led by Dragoneer Investment Group with Lightspeed, General Catalyst, Accel, and Plural, cementing its position in the AI defense sector.

top_stories.title: Video generation startup PixVerse raises $439M, valuation soars past $2B
top_stories.summary: PixVerse closed a $439 million Series C extension led by CDH Investments with Alibaba, Lollapalooza Capital, and Ivy Capital, fueling the AI video generation and world models space.

items.title: Video generation models are general-purpose vision learners (GenCeption)
items.summary: Uses a pre-trained video generative diffusion backbone as a feed-forward perception model. Achieves SOTA on depth, surface normal, camera pose, and 3D keypoint prediction with 7-500x less training data than prior methods.

items.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing limits of agents on long-horizon terminal tasks
items.summary: Introduces 46 long-horizon terminal tasks with dense reward grading. The strongest frontier model achieves just 15.2% pass@1, with agents consuming avg 9.9M tokens per task.

items.title: GATS: Graph-augmented tree search with layered world models for agent planning
items.summary: Combines UCB1-based tree search with a 3-layer world model, achieving 100% success on synthetic planning tasks with zero LLM calls during inference vs 37 for LATS.

items.title: KronQ: LLM quantization via Kronecker-factored Hessian
items.summary: PTQ framework introducing gradient covariance into quantization. At 2-bit weight-only on LLaMA-3-70B achieves 7.93 perplexity while GPTQ and GPTAQ diverge.

items.title: RIPO: Riemannian isometric policy optimization for LLM reasoning
items.summary: Reveals PPO-Clip's Euclidean metric flaw and proposes isometric updates on the Riemannian manifold. Achieves up to 60% improvement over GRPO on AIME24 across seven benchmarks.

items.title: GPT 5.6 Ultra Mode burns through limits 15x faster with sub-agent spawning
items.summary: Theo exposes a design issue in GPT 5.6's Ultra mode: what appears as a reasoning level actually spawns max-reasoning sub-agents on repeat, consuming the five-hour usage limit in as little as 20 minutes per run.

items.title: OpenAI removes standalone Codex app, merges it into ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI discontinued the standalone Codex application, folding its functionality into ChatGPT. The Codex app now redirects to ChatGPT, marking the end of Codex as a separate product for AI-powered coding.

items.title: Sqlsure — Deterministic semantic checks for AI-generated SQL
items.summary: Semantic SQL inspector that checks queries against schema facts before execution. Runs ~0.1 ms per check fully offline, Apache-2.0. Found 45 real bugs in Spider and BIRD with zero false positives.

items.title: Fudge MCP — Design reference engine for AI agents
items.summary: Lets AI agents search nearly 10,000 real websites by fonts, colors, components, and layouts. Runs locally through MCP with a Chrome extension to save design references.

items.title: FetchSandbox — API integration testing that remembers what breaks
items.summary: Runs real integration flows for AI agents building API integrations. Over 1,600 MCP installs. Catches duplicate events, stale state, and race conditions before production.

items.title: AgentKey — One-stop live data marketplace for AI agents
items.summary: Plugin connecting Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and MCP agents to live external data — search, web scraping, social media, finance — through a single account with auto-failover.

items.title: Valarian raises $50M to build a sovereign AI sealed cloud
items.summary: Series A led by NEA with SV Angel and Bain Capital Ventures for a sovereign AI and cloud security platform.

items.title: Hermes agent maker Nous Research in talks for new funding at $1.5B valuation
items.summary: Nous Research is reportedly in talks for at least $75M in Series B funding led by Robot Ventures with USV, targeting a $1.5B valuation for the open-source AI agent company.

items.title: Guthrie AI raises $4M to automate construction bidding with virtual bid assistants
items.summary: Seed round led by Chicago Ventures for an AI platform helping glass contractors bid 70% more with virtual bid assistants.
